subject: Enterprise access integration sprint & prework
messages:
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 10:15:00 -0700
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Clarke <tom.clarke@finsecure.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Subject: Enterprise access integration sprint — initial plan

Tom —

Thanks again for the time earlier. To make the SSO/SCIM/IP allowlist/service-account work as smooth as possible, I sketched a short two-week integration sprint and a small prework checklist so your infra and security teams can validate ahead of time. High level:

- Prework (requested before the kickoff):
  - SAML metadata (IdP metadata XML) and desired ACS/Entity IDs
  - SCIM provisioning mapping (CSV of attributes + example user)
  - IP allowlist CIDRs (for our egress and any customer-to-service requirements)
  - Names of any service accounts you want to create and intended role mapping
  - Org policy constraints (just links or a short doc)

- Proposed timeline:
  - Week 0 (prep): collect prework above and run basic connectivity tests
  - Week 1: SAML setup + validation, exchange metadata, verify SP-initiated flow
  - Week 2: SCIM provisioning test, service-account role mapping, IP allowlist verification and cutover checklist

We're tentatively looking at a May 24 start (two x 90m sessions during the sprint + async triage).

I've attached a short prework spreadsheet and our security overview for your reviewers. Marissa (cc'd) will lead the SCIM mapping session. If you'd like, we can loop in a direct connectivity engineer to test IP-level firewall rules.

Deliverables: SAML greenlight, SCIM test user provisioning, verified IP allowlist, service-account mapping doc, and a final cutover checklist.

Can you confirm whether the May 24 start works and share the IdP metadata and a sample user export by next Thursday (May 20)?

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
attachments: sso-scim-prework.xlsx, redwood-security-overview.pdf
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:04:00 -0700
From: Tom Clarke <tom.clarke@finsecure.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Subject: Re: Enterprise access integration sprint — initial plan

Alex —

Appreciate the clear plan. A couple quick questions from our side:

1) Service accounts: we have naming conventions and will need tokens rotated by our own vault. Do you support service-account-local names or do they have to match an email-style principal?
2) SCIM mapping: can you share an example attribute map? We use a custom attribute for "employee_type" that maps to entitlements; we'll need to preserve that.

Also please loop in our security lead, Sarah Nguyen (sarah.nguyen@finsecure.com) so she can review the prework attachments. We'll aim to get you the IdP metadata by May 19 — can you confirm the format you prefer (raw XML vs metadata URL)?

Thanks,
Tom Clarke
Director of Infrastructure
FinSecure

Subject: Re: Enterprise access integration sprint — initial plan

Tom —

Short answers:
- Service account names: we can accept both email-style principals and short service names. For your vault rotation, we support token exchange and short-lived certs; we'll document the recommended rotation window.
- SCIM map: I'll send a sample mapping (CSV) in a follow-up; Marissa will run a 30-minute mapping session during week 1 to align attributes (we support custom attributes such as "employee_type").
- IdP metadata: XML is preferred, but a metadata URL works if it's stable.

Marissa — can you confirm availability for a 30-min SCIM mapping on Week 1 (May 25 or 26)?

Alex Martinez
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Subject: Re: Enterprise access integration sprint — internal alignment

Alex / Neha —

I'll take point on the SCIM mapping session and the test harness (I'll provide a CSV of example attributes and a small script to push users into our staging environment). Neha, can you confirm what format you prefer for the IP allowlist ingestion (single CSV vs JSON)? Also, do we need a formal change window for FinSecure's firewalls or will they handle it asynchronously?

I'll prepare the sample mapping that includes the custom "employee_type" attribute Tom mentioned and a recommended role->permission matrix for the service accounts. Planning to draft the mapping doc by end of day May 18 so Alex can circulate to FinSecure.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 12:50:00 -0700
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Subject: Re: Enterprise access integration sprint — IP & policy notes

Marissa —

We can consume either CSV or JSON for IP allowlists; CSV is easiest for customers. A couple of technical constraints to flag for FinSecure (please share with them):

- We support single CIDR blocks and individual /32 entries; if you need range objects larger than /16 we'll need to review with networking.
- For inbound allowlist (customer-to-service) we will provide the canonical egress IPs; for outbound (service-to-customer) we rely on peering endpoints.
- Service-account role mapping: we'll need a mapping table that lists service-account name, allowed scopes, and TTL for tokens.

I'll assemble a short "maturity matrix" CSV that captures what we can do today vs staged enhancements and attach it before the kickoff.

Neha Kapoor
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>

Thank you — schedule confirmed. Kickoff session: May 24 @ 14:00 PDT (90m). Week 1 mapping workshop: May 25 @ 10:00 PDT (30m SCIM session led by Marissa). Week 2 cutover test: June 1 @ 11:00 PDT.

Action items for FinSecure before May 20:
- Provide IdP metadata XML (or stable metadata URL)
- Export CSV with a sample user (include custom attrs, e.g., "employee_type")
- Provide CIDR list for allowlist ingestion

Attachments and links: I've uploaded the draft maturity matrix and the updated prework sheet to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-finsecure-onboarding
Attachments: maturity-matrix.csv

If Sarah or anyone on your security team wants a short pre-kickoff sync with Neha, we can slot 30 minutes next week. Otherwise we'll proceed with the timeline above.

Looking forward —
